# EnterpriseGlue v0.28.4 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.28.3`.

## Highlights

- **developer-workflows:** Prevents staging infrastructure work from overwriting release-owned provisioning, readiness and heartbeat configuration.

## User and administrator impact

- Staging delivery guidance now distinguishes first-bootstrap metadata from release-owned serving configuration.
- Future staging troubleshooting fails closed on API/worker disagreement and retains incident locks until tenant routing is restored.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Reinstall version 0.1.12 of the EnterpriseGlue development-workflows plugin after merging this change.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- The guidance requires exact serving configuration, incident-bound evidence and generation-conditional retained-lock recovery.

## Documentation

- Updates the staging-delivery skill and maintained workflow-plugin guide.

## Known limitations

- Executable staging recovery identities remain fixed in the independently maintained EnterpriseGlue Cloud repository.

## Rollback

- Revert the plugin guidance and version bump; this does not alter deployed Cloud resources.

## Validation evidence

- Run the bundled plugin tests, official Codex skill and plugin validators, documentation-boundary guard, and release-note validation.

## Release metadata

- Release-note fragments: `staging-runtime-config-ownership`
- Audiences: developers, operators
- Compatibility: backward-compatible
